svg.aria-label: THE MAP IS A NUMBER LINE — AND THE LINE HAS A CLIFF IN IT
svg.title: Unbegotten — ONE-PAGE DESIGN · v2
svg.text: UNBEGOTTEN
Somebody always pays. Go where nobody has to.
You are a pattern with no predecessor, looking for a world that allows one.
ONE-PAGE DESIGN · v2
Haxe + Heaps / WebGL
build v0.16.0-dev.6
A cellular automaton runs on a graph. A graph has a geometry.
And whether a pattern can exist without a cause depends on
which geometry it runs on.
Not a metaphor — a theorem. The world is that theorem laid out as a number line and walked from
one end to the other. One axis carries the map, the story arc and the moral stakes: three, not four.
WITHDRAWN UNTIL EARNED: κ < 0 deletes a skill rather than raising a ramp, so the axis is not yet a difficulty
curve; and hue-encodes-κ is a proposal that graphics.Colours currently supersedes with a monotone contrast
budget. A one-pager that keeps claiming four is a one-pager nobody can check. Both are open questions.
THE THEOREM — GARDEN OF EDEN · MOORE 1962 · MYHILL 1963
erasure ⇔ orphan
orphan, no erasure
An orphan is a configuration with no possible predecessor.
Orphans exist in every geometry — that is not the distinction.
A CA is surjective ⇔ it is pre-injective: orphans exist if and only
if the rule collapses two distinct configurations onto the same
future. Uncaused and destroyed are one fact counted twice.
And that equivalence holds ⇔ the group is amenable.
Ceccherini-Silberstein–Machì–Scarabotti; converse, Bartholdi.
In an amenable world, to be uncaused, something must have been erased.
In a non-amenable one, you can be uncaused for free.
Freedom is available everywhere. What negative curvature changes is whether it has a victim.
UNIVERSAL CONSTANTS
Everything is cells.
If it exists, it is a configuration.
Alive is emissive, dead is matte.
A settling world visibly goes dark — the antagonist, rendered without a word.
Defects are ornamented, because defects are sockets.
Regularity is what makes a space unwritable. The Fold's twelve are forced by Euler,
not placed by anyone; the Sprawl is regular and has none.
No directional sunlight.
There is no outside. Light comes from the world.
THE MAP IS A NUMBER LINE — AND THE LINE HAS A CLIFF IN IT
AMENABLE — to be uncaused, someone is erased
NON-AMENABLE — nobody pays
compact
everything returns
flat
everything repeats
exponential
everywhere is edge
THE TURN OF THE GAME · where the theorem fails
The Fold
MARK
geodesic sphere, walked from inside
Compactness. Finite, closed, no boundary —
no direction is “away”.
See far, not near. You can see your whole
cage but never your own cell.
The twelve pentagons are forced by Euler, and
they are the only writable cells there are:
the sockets. SEED lives here, so does hour one.
space built
mechanic built
The Weft
PAIR
a sphere with an antipodal rule over it
That the geometry was chosen. Nothing is glued —
someone decided these two walls answer to each other.
Look toward your antipode and read a
reflection you can never touch.
One wall in five is hinged. The exit is the
beacon's antipode: the way you carve north
is the way you close south.
space built
mechanic built
The Repeat
COMPARE
many separate, identical tiles
Sameness is evidence of a shared cause,
not a property — and it is fragile.
Distance tells you nothing. Information lives
only in comparison, against what you remember.
Six kinds of wrong, tiered by ring. Each
divergence you name is a plot on one grid;
overlaid they draw a loaf — so, a choice.
space built
mechanic built
The Turn
MIRROR
flat Möbius band, non-orientable
Chirality. Handedness is not carried;
it is assigned to you by the space.
One boundary curve, twice the band's own period
long: pale for a lap, then dashed. Which rail is
beside you is which lift you are on.
A gate solid on one lift and gone on the other.
Nothing about you visibly changed. The glider
annihilation waits on CARRY.
space built
mechanic partial
The Defect
CIRCLE
a cone — flat everywhere but one point
100° gone
Holonomy. Curvature can be concentrated,
and transport is path-dependent.
Nothing looks bent. The lie shows only
when you return, turned.
Continuous, not binary: loop twice for twice the
angle. And here the Fold's twelve pentagons
retroactively become cone points.
space built
mechanic partial
The Sprawl
NAVIGATE
hyperbolic {7,3} heptagrid
Exponential growth. Rings grow by φ² a step —
measured. No Følner sets: everywhere is edge.
The Fold inverted: see near, not far. The skill
you spent hours learning is deleted.
Radius by ring-counting, taught by a raven's
flight; bearing by a pulse at ring boundaries.
Perfectly regular, so no defects and no sockets:
you can write on your cage, not on your freedom.
space built
mechanic not built
The Knot
BRAID
genus-2 surface, two handles
a
b
a
b
c
d
c
d
Topology beyond curvature: not how much
space there is, but how it connects.
One room, and many images of it. Position is
insufficient; “where am I” is a word in a group.
Verified by computation, not assertion: the deck
group's orbit matches an independent tiling, the
action is free, the count matches Gauss-Bonnet.
space built
mechanic not built
The Garden
CHOOSE
non-amenable, and authored
NOT BUILT
The one place she built where freedom is free —
the nearest she came to undoing what she did.
It has no legibility law yet, because it
has no geometry yet.
Where the choice is posed. Autonomy and Rest are
taken here; Legacy is taken by turning round.
This is the payoff of every hour before it,
and it is the one space that does not exist.
space not built
mechanic not built
OFF THE LINE — NEITHER BELONGS ON A CURVATURE AXIS
The Still Life
the hub — the only place that does not tick
RETURN
Teaches nothing, and that is the point: safety and stagnation are the same condition. Total legibility — the one honest
map in the game, and it is a map of the one place that doesn't matter. Stopping the clock here is safe and useless.
AND IT IS THE PROGRESS BAR. The hub gains curvature as you do: flat at the start, bent a little by every geometry you
come to understand. By the endgame the safe room is a non-euclidean space you had to learn to read — and you walked
into it without noticing. Diegetic, retroactive, and the only progression display the game is allowed to have.
space built
mechanic partial
The Ribbon
a world that is a line; the second axis is time
READ
Rule 110's spacetime diagram as terrain, tilted so the past descends away from you — a flat heightfield foreshortens
to nothing at eye height, and a tilted plane is still intrinsically flat, so the fix costs no geometry. Walking north
walks into the past, until generation zero, where somebody typed the initial condition. Thread 3 pays off here.
AND IT IS THE ENDGAME'S TUTORIAL. This is where you learn to run the rule backwards — the only way to recognise,
hours later, that a pattern in the Sprawl has no predecessor and that nothing was erased to balance it.
space built
mechanic partial
THE ANTAGONIST IS SETTLING
There are no enemies, and there should not be. Random soup evaporates within a few dozen generations into scattered
still lifes and blinkers — measured in this repo, 2026-07-29. The world is dying by settling: running out of interesting
states, resolving into stable accounted configurations that can never surprise anyone again. A fully settled world is a
fully accounted world, which is precisely the amenable condition you are trying to escape. So the clock is real, the
tension needs no monsters, and the antagonist is the same force as the thesis — already rendered by constant 2.
TWO SCALES
At walking scale you are a figure. At pattern scale you are a configuration, and so is everything else.
Some things are legible at only one: a glider is five meaningless cells up close, and unmistakable from outside.
FAILURE
Cheap, informative, rare. A disrupted configuration reforms at the
last socket, losing the moment and nothing else. You never lose
knowledge — understanding cannot be taken back, and since progression
is perception there is literally nothing else to drop.
WHAT YOU ACTUALLY DO
Seven verbs, four already running. None is ever explained: no menu, no HUD, no journal, no map.
WALK
first person on a curved surface, free and unrestricted
BUILT
hyperbolic walking validated by playtest, 2026-08-12
LOOK
read a space by its own legibility law
BUILT
the Fold's law; every space is a different instrument
TICK
set the rate the rule runs at
BUILT
slow to think; fast to skip a chain you have already reasoned out; stop is safe and useless
SEED
write cells into the substrate, at a defect
BUILT
pentagon engraving — sockets are the only writable cells there are
READ
learn a configuration by watching one full cycle
NEW
the progression spine, and the reason there is no journal
CARRY
move a pattern between geometries
BACKLOG
a glider tuned to 6 neighbours may not survive on 7 — already measured
ZOOM
shift between walking scale and pattern scale
BACKLOG
blocks the Defect's socket and the Turn's annihilation both
HOW IT GATES
On understanding, never on permission.
READ — HOW IT REMEMBERS WITHOUT A JOURNAL
You learn a configuration by watching it complete one full cycle.
Observation is acquisition: nothing is awarded, logged or announced.
There is no ship log because the world is the log.
THE KNOWLEDGE WEB — NO KEYS, NO FLAGS
A wall in the Fold opens only on even generations → read its period
→ recognise the oscillator driving it → the clearest one to learn from
is in the Repeat → which needs only the walk and the patience to watch.
The Sprawl's centre cannot be found by looking → derive an algorithm
→ ring-counting is demonstrated by a raven's flight, watched from the
Fold's far side → bearing arrives as a pulse at ring boundaries.
A Sprawl pattern has no predecessor and nothing was erased to balance
it → remarkable only if you can already run the rule backwards → which
the Ribbon teaches by making history walkable.
FOUR THREADS — BRAIDED, NOT SEQUENCED
The Reconstruction — the spine
You are already past the taxonomy with no memory of how, so it is archaeology,
not a career. It ends when the chain fails to reach you.
The Predecessors — who was here before
Ghosts are oscillators: awake, and unable to learn. Still lifes are the ones who stopped —
the terrain is made of people who gave up. Ravens are gliders, still travelling.
The Gardener — who made this, and why
The prison is a cradle: you were incubated. And she became free the cheap way,
here, so someone was spent for her. The hub is an apology — derived, never told.
The Rule — can it change
Editable at the sockets, but your own configuration is only stable under the
current rule. Self-modification with lethal stakes: it makes the end a choice.
PROGRESSION IS PERCEPTION
Never power, never a mode, never an item. Each unlock re-reads everywhere you have already been.
Colour
the world starts desaturated; routes that were always physically there
Pattern scale
the cellular truth under the walking-scale view
Period sight
an oscillator's period on sight — the ghosts become legible as what they are
Reverse reading
running the rule backwards over what you can see
Ring sense
counting hyperbolic distance by ear
The world does not open up. You do.
THE ENDGAME — THREE POSITIONS ON ONE QUESTION, AND THE GAME REFUSES TO RANK THEM
Each is reached by walking somewhere and doing something. No menu, no prompt, no confirmation — and each is stated here with both halves, because a cost without a gift is a ranking in disguise.
1 · AUTONOMY
taken in the Garden
Become uncaused in non-amenable space,
where no erasure balances you.
Free in the strongest sense the mathematics
allows, and nobody paid.
An orphan has no predecessor in either direction: nothing that
follows can trace itself to you. Perfect autonomy is indistinguishable
from perfect isolation — the discovery the Gardener already made. It is
also the slowest route, and the cheap one has been on offer for hours.
2 · LEGACY
taken by turning round
Stay in the amenable world and seed the
conditions for others to wake.
Freedom becomes possible for someone,
which it was not before you.
You remain caused, accounted and embedded, and you personally never
become free. This is the one ending reached by walking back the way
you came: the Garden poses the choice, it does not hold all three —
an amenable ending cannot be taken in a non-amenable space.
3 · REST
taken in the Garden
Let the rule take you.
Not despair.
The dignity of a pattern that chooses to stop
rather than persist at any cost.
Everything you understood stops with you, and the archaeology of
Thread 1 ends unfinished. The ghosts have spent the whole game
arguing this by being the alternative: persistence bought by looping,
and looping is exactly what costs them the ability to learn.
HONEST SCOPE
An 8–15 hour non-euclidean game is a 3–5 year project at solo pace with contract art and audio. That is arithmetic, not pessimism.
PHASE 0 IS COMPLETE. Hyperbolic walking: validated, played 2026-08-12. BECOME: built, played and cut. Both existential risks retired — one yes, one no.
PHASE 1 is the Fold, the Sprawl, and the transition between them — shippable on its own, because the thesis is that transition.
OF THE TEN SPACES: nine have geometry, three have their mechanic. The Garden has neither, and the Garden is the endgame.
STILL OPEN: whether compact travelling structures exist at all on {7,3} — 972 rules survive 120 generations, travellers unsearched · whether the Turn's repeated
traversal can be made pleasurable · how honest the simulation must be · hue-encodes-κ or the monotone contrast budget · the Knot may have to precede the Sprawl.

Method: one-page design after Stone Librande (GDC 2010) — visual first, subtractive, dated, pinnable. The figures are computed rather than sketched: the heptagrid is a real {7,3}, the Ribbon is real Rule 110.
